d: In the US, a 5-year-old boy is found dead after a trip to Disneyland with his father, and in the UK, a parking dispute escalates into a double murder.

In Texas, a husband "fails" to stop his wife from taking her own life with a gunshot to the back of her head. Home surveillance reveals the truth. In Washington state, a man builds a bunker in secret with a diabolical plan for his wife and daughter.
A staged stalking narrative unravels under police scrutiny. In another case, investigators expose how financial exploitation leads to brutal torture and murder.

st: The Real Life Thelma and Louise
d: Bernadette and her lover make tabloid headlines when they lure men to their hotel rooms to rob them at gunpoint. Instead of filing for divorce, Leilani coerces her children to kill her husband.
This episode features Jocelyn, who was found guilty of fatally stabbing her lover, and Gwen, who claimed she heard voices that told her to sacrifice her husband to God.
This episode features a woman who murdered her husband and another who schemed to kill a witness in her nephew's murder case.

t: Bloodline Detectives hosted by Nancy Grace
d: A killer evades justice for the murder of Diana Hanson for 38 years until genetic genealogy can identify him.
